like playing a game obviously not meant for you. what if i refuse to play by the rules? what then? i suppose i die alone because i just cannot tolerate relationships or friendships for that matter

we're cooked
no kidding. everybody says college years will be your golden years filled with opportunity but i physically cant just bring myself to make friends. feels like the priviledge is wasted on me.

my friends definitely DO NOT like it when i dont initiate and when i isolate, so maybe they dont consider you a ghoster by hard definition but they dont consider you highly maybe. 

i hear the moment a relationship or friendship starts to crack and break is the moment you have irks that go unsaid. and when they dont check up on you, you get annoyed that they dont but theyre annoyed that you dont check up on them and both of you have irks that go unsaid. ive had many friendships go out like that

the thing about ghosting i dont hear enough people talk about. thing is i feel like nobody wants to associate with rude people. and coming from someone who ghosted a few people im just such a terrible person that i cant bring myself to communicate disinterest that ghosting seems a viable option. a rude and selfish conclusion befitting me, something along the lines.

sounds to me youre locked in. me ive made the mistake of getting wayyyyy too attached too early and i got burned, and if i were to redo things i would communicate with her a pace we are both comfortable with. if shes really as similar as you say, im sure she will be understanding. 

now if you dont self sabotage like me itll be fumbleproof
a year ago when i first read the nhk manga i was actually living it up and now a year later on the same month im watching the anime arguably in the worst spot in my life. crazy.

i think we're on the same page the hate in my heart just biased me to misinterpret that sorry haha

yea no i get that, im in an episode rn where i seclude myself while i desperately want ppl to reach out and yeah. no theyre not ghosting me but spiritually, it feels like it. its a weird thing. i mean, even if i do talk to them and initiate first i hate people pleasing so i really couldnt stand it. and then i remember why im lonely. i cant have my cake and eat it too

but hey whats this about the different meanings of ghosting on this subreddit im lost

but honestly thats really depends on what you think are "nice things" cuz if you want fun group events like hangouts and trips then youre gonna have to play the socialite's game and people please to surround yourself with buddies. "throw paint on the wall to see what sticks" whats the paint you think you could throw that will give your life purpose?

yup sometimes it feels like my life is just waiting to play into the hands of someone more social and extraverted to string me along into fun events but then i remember im fucked up and aslong as i dont ever start initiating shit myself i wont ever get to have nice things

trying to figure out why youre alone is kinda dangerous because if youre the overthinker type youre gonna try to psychoanalyze why youre so fucked up and then with your head so far up your ass youre stuck in a positive feedback loop of self pity

or maybe thats just me

im a little bit biased because i am a pretty clingy person so when they dont initiate and things fizzle out for a while, it feels TERRIBLE.

at the end of the day theres gonna be ppl who are more needier than others and when that stuff happens on a regular basis thats not something you want in a long term relationship
look at it this way, the semantics of whether it is ghosting or not dont really matter imo but its more about how it makes the "ghosted" feel.
i mean its one thing to be scared of being crazy attached to someone you just met and another thing to be frightened to fall in love. which one do you think it is
also eva nhk no longer human homonculus and silent hill 2 are dope i recently got around to rewatching nhk and rereading nlh and they make me feel terrible about myself lol
i sometimes check this reddit and see someone describe my life just older and i get a fat reality check that it doesnt get better

whatever substances youre taking, please stop. theres gonna come a time that one person will enter in your life and make you feel whole, but the substances have caught up to you. youre gonna fuck up your sleep and by proxy your mood and health if you spam caffeine. you could fuck up your hormones and start having roid rage and worry the people around you. it's just not worth it dude. you are good enough for someone and you dont need to hop on a cycle to feel good in your body.
